explication: dnSpy is a .NET and Unity assembly debugger, editor, and analysis workbench. A typical workflow loads or inspects an assembly, presents decompiled or metadata views, then lets the user analyze, edit, or debug it; edits can be compiled and applied to assembly metadata. The graph preserves the documented debugger, editor, hex, decompiler, analyzer, BAML, and search capabilities. Most feature links are documented in the README; sampled implementation shows debugger engine/message references and hex metadata-view relationships, but not all UI wiring.
